summary: Implemented terminal window title support, without committing or running tests. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a (ControlType, str) member in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 format entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and Control.title(); rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title() beside show_cursor, returning True only when is_terminal; rich/_windows_renderer.py dispatches SET_WINDOW_TITLE to term.set_title(control[1]); CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added in tests/test_console.py (skipped on win32), tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows only). Not verified: tests and Black formatting were not run, per instructions. Choice made: OSC 0 was used for the title sequence since the spec gave the prefix without the OSC number.
